title: Robinhood CEO：预测市场成增长最快业务
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The numbers are decent. I mean, let's ignore, for example, the one and a half percent drop you're seeing in the shares here.
segments.zh: 数据还不错。比如，先忽略股价下跌1.5%这个点。

segments.en: I want to talk about growth and where the next leg of growth comes. You add a huge bump-up in growth in the prediction markets business.
segments.zh: 我想谈谈增长，以及下一阶段的增长点。你在预测市场业务上看到了大幅增长。

segments.en: I understand it's a new business, so obviously the growth would be there. Was that just sort of one-off in terms of the growth because of the world cup and all the other things that have been going on in the world? Or is that sustainable?
segments.zh: 我知道这是新业务，所以增长明显。但这是否只是受世界杯等因素影响的一次性增长？还是可持续的？

segments.en: Prediction markets has been growing consistently since launch. It's the fastest growing business in our history. Well into the mid-hundreds of millions of annualized revenue, so that's been strong and we expect it to continue to be strong.
segments.zh: 预测市场自推出以来持续增长，是我们历史上增长最快的业务。年化收入已达数亿美元，势头强劲，预计将继续保持。

segments.en: We have football season on the sports side coming up, as well as the midterms, which if you remember the origin of prediction markets in this current super cycle, it really started with the 2024 election.
segments.zh: 体育方面有足球赛季，还有中期选举。如果回顾预测市场的起源，这一轮超级周期始于2024年大选。

segments.en: So we're expecting that this election is similarly going to be a big event. But also one of the stories of the quarter, Robinhood has begun to diversify and that's accelerated over time.
segments.zh: 我们预计这次选举也将是重大事件。但本季度的另一个亮点是，Robinhood已开始多元化，且步伐加快。

segments.en: We now have thirteen business lines generating over a hundred million in annualized revenue, including Robinhood Legend, which is our pro-trading platform, as well as the Robinhood credit card.
segments.zh: 我们现在有13条业务线年化收入超过1亿美元，包括专业交易平台Robinhood Legend和Robinhood信用卡。

segments.en: That's what I'm curious about. I mean because yes, it is incredibly diversified now. But when we look at certain growths, I mean some people are wondering, does the prediction market become sort of one of the bigger parts of this business over time? Or is your goal to try to keep at least some of the main components of those thirteen lines relatively imbalanced?
segments.zh: 这正是我好奇的。现在确实非常多元化。但看某些增长，有人想知道，预测市场是否会成为业务中更大的部分？还是你的目标是保持这13条线相对均衡？
